Project changes: an independent CPU-only NumPy/ONNX Runtime adapter, bounded approved-artifact catalog, strict tensor validation, normalized person-only output and supervised local shadow integration. No upstream training code, model weights or media are included here. This file is project attribution, not an upstream NOTICE or endorsement.
